meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能规划、配置、运行和检查 FluidSim 流体模拟——设定计算区域、网格、粘度等参数，执行模拟，并输出速度场、涡量、能谱等分析结果。支持2D/3D Navier-Stokes、浅水方程、分层流等，还支持 MPI 并行计算。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行流体动力学模拟（二维/三维Navier-Stokes、浅水方程、分层流），或要求分析湍流、涡旋动力学、地球物理流时触发。

say.text: 用分层流求解器模拟，设置N=2，初始场用高斯团。
把模拟结果给我画出来：涡量场和一维能谱。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude plan, configure, run, and inspect FluidSim simulations—set domain, mesh, viscosity, run the solver, and analyze outputs like velocity, vorticity, spectra. Supports 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flows, and MPI parallel runs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for fluid dynamics simulations (2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flows) or to analyze turbulence, vortex dynamics, geophysical flows.

say_en.text: Set up a 512x512 2D Navier-Stokes simulation with viscosity 1e-4, run until t=50.
say_en.note: Claude configures and starts the simulation.

say_en.text: Run a stratified flow simulation with N=2 and a Gaussian blob initial field.
Plot the vorticity field and 1D energy spectrum from the results.
